about.title: Neighbourhood dental care that puts you at ease
body: Bloom Dental Clinic was opened to give Mugalivakkam families a dental clinic they could actually walk to — tucked into Subasree Nagar Extension, right near the MKM school front gate, so it's an easy stop whether you're dropping kids at school or heading home from work.
Because we're so close to a school, we see a lot of children come through our doors, which shaped how we practice: patient, unhurried, and never intimidating, whether you're 6 or 60.

Every treatment — from a routine cleaning to a root canal or implant — is explained clearly before it begins, so you always know what to expect and never feel rushed through a decision about your own care.
highlights: A short walk from MKM school and Subasree Nagar Ext homes
Gentle, patient approach for a child's first dental visit
Every procedure explained before it starts — no surprises
Evening hours so a visit doesn't mean missing work or school

services.name: General Dental Checkups
services.tagline: Routine care that catches problems early
services.overview: A thorough, relaxed checkup covering cleaning, cavity checks, and gum health, with time set aside to answer any questions you have.
procedure: Review of dental and medical history
Full mouth examination and X-rays if needed
Professional cleaning and plaque removal
Discussion of findings and any next steps
benefits: Catches cavities and gum issues early
No pressure or upselling of treatments
A comfortable starting point for nervous or first-time patients

services.name: Painless Root Canal Treatment
services.overview: Root canal treatment using modern anesthesia and a slow, communicative approach designed for patients who dread the procedure.
symptoms: Sensitivity to hot or cold that lingers
Swelling or tenderness in the gums
procedure: Diagnosis and X-ray to confirm the issue
Local anesthesia, applied gradually and checked
Cleaning and shaping of the root canal
Sealing and, if needed, a protective crown
benefits: Every step explained before it happens
Breaks offered throughout for nervous patients
services.recovery: Mild sensitivity for a day or two is normal; most patients return to regular activity the same day.

faqs.question: Is a root canal really painful?
faqs.answer: With modern anesthesia and technique, most patients feel little more than pressure. We go at your pace and check in throughout.

services.name: Dental Implants
services.overview: Titanium implants that replace missing teeth with a stable, natural-feeling result, placed with careful planning and clear communication at each stage.
symptoms: A loose or failing bridge or denture
procedure: Consultation and imaging
Implant placement under local anesthesia
Healing period with regular check-ins
Custom crown fitting
benefits: Looks and functions like a natural tooth
Built to last with proper care
services.recovery: Mild swelling for a few days is normal; the full healing period before the crown is fitted typically takes a few months.

faqs.question: Is the implant procedure painful?
faqs.answer: It's done under local anesthesia, so the placement itself is comfortable. We manage any post-procedure discomfort with clear aftercare guidance.

services.name: Teeth Whitening
services.tagline: A brighter smile in a single visit
services.overview: Safe, dentist-supervised whitening that lifts stains and discoloration without damaging enamel.
procedure: Shade assessment and suitability check
Gum protection applied
Whitening gel application under supervision
Final shade check and aftercare guidance
benefits: Noticeably brighter smile in one sitting
services.recovery: Some temporary sensitivity is common for a day; avoiding staining foods for 48 hours helps results last.

services.name: Pediatric Dentistry

services.overview: A calm, friendly approach to children's dental care, built around our location near MKM school — designed to make early visits comfortable so good dental habits start young.

Simple examination at the child's pace
Cleaning, cavity checks, and sealants where needed

blogPosts.title: Helping Your Child Feel Comfortable at the Dentist
blogPosts.excerpt: Being located right next to MKM school, we see a lot of first-time young patients — here's what actually helps make that visit a good one.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Karthik Subramaniam
content: A child's first dental visit sets the tone for how they'll feel about dental care for years to come, which is why we treat it as its own kind of appointment — slower, gentler, and much more about comfort than treatment.

The single biggest thing that helps is familiarity. Letting a child simply look around the room, sit in the chair, and meet the dentist before anything actually happens removes most of the fear of the unknown.
Language matters too — describing tools in simple, non-scary terms and narrating what's happening as it happens keeps a child engaged rather than anxious.

Parents can help by keeping their own language neutral beforehand — avoiding words like 'pain' or 'hurt' even when reassuring — and by scheduling the visit for a time of day when their child isn't already tired or hungry.
Since we're right by the school gate, many of our young patients come straight from a school day. We keep that in mind and always let a child set the pace of their own visit.
